nodes.prompt_template: Write a concise, professional executive biography (90-120 words) for a person whose role and field are described as: {concept}. Use a confident third-person voice. Avoid clichés. End with a single sentence about leadership philosophy.

Professional business portrait. Subject: {concept}. Studio lighting, soft key light from camera-left, subtle fill, neutral light-grey seamless backdrop, sharp eyes, shallow depth of field, mid-length crop from chest up, neutral expression, business attire.
Write a one-sentence visual direction for a business portrait expressing: {concept}. Mention lighting, framing, and wardrobe. Keep it concrete and under 40 words.
Business portrait photography. Concept: {concept}. Follow the provided visual direction. Realistic skin texture, natural color grading, sharp focus on the eyes, shallow depth of field.
Draft a LinkedIn-style professional summary (3 short paragraphs) for the following person and role: {concept}. Use a warm but confident tone. No emojis. No hashtags.
Modern business portrait, environmental office setting, large window soft daylight, slight smile, business-casual attire. Subject context: {concept}.
Write a cinematic, single-paragraph creative direction for a 5-second branded portrait reel for: {concept}. Specify camera move, lighting mood, wardrobe, and one defining gesture. Under 80 words.

Cinematic business portrait still frame for a brand reel. Subject: {concept}. Warm rim light, dark moody backdrop, 35mm film look, eye contact with camera, tailored suit. Frame composed to allow subtle camera push-in.
Animate a slow 5-second cinematic camera push-in on the subject. Subtle ambient motion in hair and fabric. Maintain identity and lighting from the source frame. Subject context: {concept}.
